title: CHIEF: detecting cancer and predicting survival from slides
summary: Trained on 15 million patches and 60,000 slides and tested on more than 19,400 slides from 32 datasets and 24 hospitals: it detects cancer with about 94% accuracy across 15 datasets, predicts mutations in 54 genes with over 70% accuracy, and improves survival prediction by 8% across 17 institutions. Retrospective validation; not trained on rare diseases or premalignant tissue.
